'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Al Jazeera]] reports that [[Hamas]] has agreed to retreat via [[Red Cross]] corridors from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] areas that are under [[Israel]]i control per the [[Gaza peace plan|peace plan]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-11-02/ty-article-live/u-s-military-publishes-video-of-palestinians-looting-an-aid-truck-in-southern-gaza/0000019a-429d-d4b1-adbe-6fbfba3b0000#1844466313 (Haaretz)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Netherlands]] agrees to [[repatriation (cultural property)|repatriate]] an [[Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt|Eighteenth Dynasty]] statue from the reign of [[Pharaoh]] [[Thutmose III]] to [[Egypt]] after investigators determine it was illegally taken from the country and later found at an [[Arts festival|art fair]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/netherlands-return-3500-year-old-sculpture-egypt-2025-11-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The death toll from [[flooding]] in [[Vietnam]] increases to 35, with five people still missing.  [https://www.msn.com/en-in/news/world/vietnam-flood-death-toll-rises-to-35-says-disaster-agency-five-more-still-missing/ar-AA1PElLU (MSN)]
*At least 15 people are killed and two others are injured after a passenger vehicle collides head-on with a truck in [[Jodhpur]], [[India]]. [https://www.news18.com/india/over-18-killed-after-tempo-traveller-crashes-into-truck-in-jodhpur-9675599.html (''Dawn'')]
*Four girls drown in an irrigation canal in [[Srirangapatna taluk]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/karnataka/children-drown-in-canal-in-srirangapatna/article70232244.ece (The Hindu)]
*Two people are killed after a [[light aircraft]] crashes in [[Fátima, Tocantins|Fátima]], [[Tocantins]], [[Brazil]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/561374 (Aviation Safety Network)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Philippines relations]]
**[[Canada]] and the [[Philippines]] sign a [[visiting forces agreement]] allowing military personnel to train in each other's territories. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/philippines-canada-sign-pact-troops-deepen-defence-ties-2025-11-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nigeria–United States relations]], [[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The [[Nigerian government]] says that it welcomes assistance from the [[United States]] to combat [[Islamic terrorism]], but adds that its sovereignty must be respected, in response to [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] threatening military action to protect [[Nigerian Christian|Christians]] from [[Persecution of Christians in Nigeria|persecution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-welcomes-us-assistance-fight-terrorism-presidency-spokesperson-says-2025-11-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests]]
**[[Serbia]]n [[Police of Serbia|police]] arrest 37 protesters near the [[House of the National Assembly, Belgrade|parliament house]] in [[Belgrade]] after clashes between pro-[[Cabinet of Đuro Macut|government]] supporters and protesters demanding justice for victims of the [[Novi Sad]] [[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse|railway station canopy collapse]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/serbian-police-detain-37-after-anti-government-clashes-2025-11-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 North Macedonian local elections]]
**[[North Macedonians]] vote in the second round of the local elections for councillors and mayors of 80 municipalities and [[Skopje]], with the ruling conservative party [[VMRO-DPMNE]] expected to [[landslide victory|win by a landslide]]. [https://apnews.com/article/north-macedonia-skopje-elections-garbage-dd75ea46c71d02e1b19df34873b20b32 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 NASCAR Cup Series]]
**In [[stock car racing]], [[Hendrick Motorsports]]' [[Kyle Larson]] wins his second [[NASCAR]] [[NASCAR Cup Series|Cup Series]] championship on an overtime finish over [[Joe Gibbs Racing]]'s [[Denny Hamlin]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nascar/2025/11/02/nascar-2025-championship-race-updates-drivers-results/87047496007/ (USA Today)]
*[[2025 Women's Cricket World Cup]]
**In [[cricket (sport)|cricket]], the [[India women's national cricket team|Indian women's team]] defeats [[South Africa women's national cricket team|South Africa]] by 52 runs to win the 13th edition of the [[Women's Cricket World Cup]].
